//: Big school groups. A school matching one is shown as e.g. 'k12 · Nord Anglia' in the School Type column, because who owns a school decides its pay scale, its HR and whether you can transfer between campuses.
//match: Case-insensitive regular expression, tested against the school name and its website. Keep it tight — a loose pattern will claim schools the group does not own.
//note: Cognia is deliberately absent: it is an accreditation agency, not an owner. Cognita, one letter away, is a group.

//portal: portal is the group's own recruitment page, each one fetched and confirmed rather than guessed. portalKind says why the scraper cannot read it: a JS portal renders in the browser, robots-blocked means their robots.txt refuses crawlers — which stops this scraper, not a person with a browser. scraped:true means the group is already read automatically and registering only keeps a profile on file.
